fractures.line_basis: Ni 2021 (full text read): superior view, a transverse line in front of the posterior facet runs inward through the sulcus to the medial wall just in front of the middle facet and forward into the medial third of the calcaneocuboid joint; a lengthwise line from the sulcus through the middle of the posterior facet runs posteromedially and splits the bone into anteromedial and posterolateral fragments; lateral wall from Gissane back to the rear of the tuberosity; no line through the sustentaculum.
fractures.note: Ni found no subtypes: this is one typical pattern from the map. Their cohort: Sanders II 24 %, III 26 %, IV 50 %.

fractures.name: Shi 2023 map pattern (inverted Y on the lateral wall, 81 intra-articular fractures)

sources.ref: Shi G et al. 3D mapping of intra-articular calcaneal fractures. Sci Rep 2023;13:8831

fractures.line_basis: Shi 2023 (full text and Figs 6-8 read): lateral wall: hot zone from Gissane back to the rear of the tuberosity, an inverted Y, ending at mid-height of the tuberosity in Fig 8 (built so; the mean angle 29.1 deg has an SD of 36.9 deg and would reach the sole), with a leg down from Gissane (Compendium S94); medial wall: in front of the medial process of the tuberosity, to the sole; axial: along the posterior facet and sulcus to the rear of the tuberosity, mean 11.0 deg; comminution at Gissane and in front of the posterior facet (the outer facet piece is broken in 2).
fractures.note: Shi found no subtypes: one typical pattern. Their cohort: Sanders I 17 %, II 31 %, III 32 %, IV 22 %; 92.5 % comminuted.
